master.onBody: Jev is running: the command gate on machines, the server C3 comparison and the features below, each in its own mode.
master.offBody: The machine gate, the server C3 comparison and all four features are stopped. Everything runs as if Jev did not exist.
master.failed: Could not change the master switch

confirm.title: Turn off all of Jev?
confirm.body: Jev stops everywhere: the command gate on machines (they notice on their next config pull), the server C3 comparison and all four features below (complexity flag, approval-note check, request-type hint, inbox badge). Nothing is deleted; turning it back on resumes.

features.modes: Each feature has three modes. Off: Jev is never called. Log only: Jev is called and measured, owners see nothing. On: shown to owners. No mode changes data by itself.
features.masterOff: The master switch is off, so no feature runs whatever its mode below.

complexity.name: Complexity check
complexity.hint: Child tasks touching security, permissions, migrations or public APIs that the Assistant did not rate large get a flag on the issue page and the map. No model change, no comment.

approval_note.name: Approval note check
approval_note.hint: Reads the note on Approve or Request changes; if it points the opposite way from the button it asks once. Slower than 1.5 s or any error sends right away.

request_type.name: Request type hint
request_type.hint: Reads title and description to suggest Code, Bug, Research, Docs or Plan as a chip you click to apply. Never changes your choice.

inbox_attention.name: Needs your attention
inbox_attention.hint: Badges inbox items with a pending owner decision, sensitive file changes, or a product decision the Assistant made on its own.
